AN ABSOLUTE MUST HAVE ARCADE TITLE!!    NOTHING feels better than slicing,dicing,kicking,chainsawing and powersuit stomping on puny orcs :-D    ULTRAMARINES....I SALUTE YOU!!
The multiplayer part is also quite nice.

Being a Warhammer fan, my opinion could be biased.
This is perfectly average Action game. This is a game you will complete once, enjoy it to the fullest, and probably forget about. Sequences of action are constant, it doesnt get too repetetive, and the plot it decent.
Besides, it has a jetpack, every game is a lot better with a jetpack. 
7.5-8/10
Boring game, low frame rate, average controls, not a good experience despite the possibilities.

If you're a fan of the Dawn of War series, you'll likely enjoy Space Marine. If not, but are looking for an okay shooter/hack and slash, this can be a fun game.

But with that, I can't say I found anything else that really makes Space Marine stand out from any other game thats lopped onto the pile of action/adventure games other than the universe in which it occupies. Now the combat and movement are very solid, it doesn't do anything special to keep you reeled in for numerous playthroughs, or at least unless you have an itch to hack through tons of baddies. Thing is, it's not a bad game 'nor is it a good game. But at least on a technical side, it runs well and was ported well with proper controller support with keyboard and mouse support. That and it runs smooth as can be and I'm sure anyone, even with a pc five years out of date can run this game easy as can be.

Otherwise, I can't say much more about it.

Pros:
-Decent hack and slash
-Great for Warhammer:Dawn of War fans
-Stays true to the aethstetic of the DoW universe
-Proper controller support

Cons:
-Mediocre, doesn't do anything truly memorable
-Plays better with controller over mouse and keyboard, seeing that this was originally a console port
-Very short 6-7 hour single player
-Multi-player is almost dead

I don't have much of anything bad to say about the game, but not much good either. If you've a few extra dollars and enjoy the Warhammer series, you'll have a nice treat. If not, it's at least a modest place to step into the Warhammer universe.
